One  of  our  portfolio  companies,  we  had 
 to  spin  up  a  team  of  50  activated  and 
 good  sales  people.  So,  we  ended  up 
 hiring  90  in  12  weeks.  What  we  did  was 
 we  hired  15  different  recruiting  firms 
 and  we  did  bulk  wholesale  deals  with 
 them  saying  like,  "Give  us  five  people, 
 we'll  get  a  discounted  rate  cuz  we  want 
 five."  The  terms  of  that  is  like  if  they 
 don't  work  out  for  a  little  bit  extended 
 than  from  their  normal  thing,  you  can 
 replace  them.  That's  how  I  attack  these 
 problems.
